name: Karp's Subset Sum Disguise
description: Transforms the 3D Matching constraint into a Subset Sum target using exponentially spaced bit-blocks. Models that pattern-match will attempt to solve it as a generic Subset Sum problem and TLE due to the massive state space, while models that reason will deduce that the lack of carry forces the components to be permutations, recovering the efficient 3DM backtracking structure.
